title: TP-Link Tapo C410 Solar-Powered Security Camera Kit 2-Pack $99 Delivered @ Amazon AU
body:
Deal: TP-Link Tapo C410 Solar-Powered Security Camera Kit 2-Pack $99 Delivered @ Amazon AU

[Herb Utsmellz] Hang on… So they've still gotta be charged??
[Runatme] I think that is if they're not connected to solar
[Runatme] You can run these without the solar panel
[Herb Utsmellz] @Runatme: So why would you buy them with solar panels?
[Runatme] @Herb Utsmellz: 1 camera alone is currently $88. Why not get 2 for $99?
[OZKap] @Herb Utsmellz: If you want to use them with solar panels.
i.e. if you don't want to run PoE to them or power them from an AC adapter.
[foreverphoenix] Look it up on the product. By the time you done asking these questions the deal is finished. Which it has
[Herb Utsmellz] Not real clear, picture shows 4 cameras, title says 2 pack and Rrp says $298 based off $97 individual price…
[tunzafun001] ..ah come on….camera wouldn't even start recording by the time this deal has passed.
[Lingnoi] Why y'all always honeypot us with this pic with 4 hahah
[Schrodinger] Back up. Bought. Thanks! It's cheap for 2 cams and 2 panels with batteries
[nowich] I've been trying to figure out how many cameras it comes with, but I could never quite work it out, and every time I checked, it was out of stock. I think it's a 2-camera system, not a 4-camera one.
[freoleo] Ordered, always miss these, says 2 pack so expecting that to come
[Jashjoso] is it 4 set or 2 sets? picture is tricky
[Montague] Don't use the picture, use the item description. You get the White 2pack Cameras for 99
[Quachyy] Either way its a cheap deal especially if you already have tapo cameras at home .. if 4 cameras it will be a bonus .. hopefully the pickers at the warehouse make a picking error :D
[Jashjoso] any deals for micro sd card for these camera??? Thanks.
[highguy88] I can’t believe I finally got ‘em! Thank you OP!
[UncleRico] Cheap solar cam with no storage. Decent if you've got no capacity to add a real POE or WiFi cam with constant recording. Better than nothing.
Just…
[placard] These are getting wifi jammed these days too.
[UncleRico] Negging (and whining four times) because it's currently sold out?
Weak…
[flickr] Showing as available again. Purchased one. Thanks OP.
[driva] ordered and it took $6 off for some DYI discount.
[gamer9119] This or eufy for no subscription home cameras?
[ritzaus] After ordering, it just shows the one camera kit? Double checking..
[theUnderdog] I have 4 at home now and wanting to get more haha
[chillybags] Seeing mixed results online. Will these integrate with home assistant?
[beepboopbaap] I use mine with frigate and its better to use wired cameras that are always on
[theUnderdog] Yes they are. You can use the Tapo Camera add on, or use Frigate
[maddoglee] Yeah it works but I find that it can’t sustain constant recording. It’s a bit useless unless you want a camera to look at stuff at home rather than constantly recording or using motion control
[Xizor] Interested in the C460. Come on black friday!
[TerryTightwad] Really good deal, but really confusing how amazon often has multiple listing of the same items. I bought some under 2, but on the order no mention of 2 cameras, clicking the link on the order shows the single camera page, so I cancelled the order thinking I made a mistake. Ordered again and the same happened, so its like they cant be clear how many someone is ordering, and also change the link to a single item to confuse them.
[Amr911] Tried my luck …found it showing $99! With "only one left"
Buy now think later!
My first cameras ever!
